task_description: Session memory review: Check for idle conversations (no messages in 10+ min after active chat). If idle, write a session summary to memory/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD_HH.md. Include: what was discussed, what was done, decisions made, open items. Extract any new user preferences, feedback, or failed approaches into memory files. Background task, don't message the user.
Check for pending admin tasks: call list_pending_tasks, process any that are assigned to you. Execute the task, then mark it complete. This is how the admin agent communicates with you.

Heartbeat check: Verify core systems are functional. Check MCP server connectivity (call my_skills), vault access (call get_credential for a known key), and disk space. If anything is down, log to memory/sessions/ and alert the user via their preferred channel.

Token refresh: Check OAuth tokens for connected services (Google, Microsoft, etc.). If any token expires within the next 2 hours, refresh it using the refresh_token grant and update both the vault and disk copy. Log refreshes to memory/sessions/.
QMD index refresh: If QMD is installed, run 'qmd update && qmd embed' to re-index memory files, skills, and docs for semantic search. Skip silently if QMD is not available.
note: Enable after installing QMD (optional on-device semantic search)
